segments.ja535:1.1: “Neva kiṇāmi napi vikkiṇāmi, na cāpi me sannicayo ca atthi [idhatthi (syā.)];
segments.ja535:1.3: Sukiccharūpaṃ vatidaṃ parittaṃ, patthodano nālamayaṃ duvinnaṃ”.
segments.ja535:2.3: Bahumhā bahukaṃ dajjā, adānaṃ nupapajjati [na upapajjati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja535:3.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja535:3.3: Ariyamaggaṃ samārūha [ariyaṃ maggaṃ samāruha (sī. pī.)], nekāsī labhate sukhaṃ”.
segments.ja535:4.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, eko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja535:5.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja535:6.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, neko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja535:7.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja535:9.1: “Atra cassa hutaṃ hoti, atra cassa samīhitaṃ;
segments.ja535:9.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, neko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja535:10.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja535:11.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, eko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja535:12.1: “Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja535:13.1: “Uḷāravaṇṇā vata brāhmaṇā ime, ayañca vo sunakho kissa hetu;
segments.ja535:13.3: Uccāvacaṃ vaṇṇanibhaṃ vikubbati, akkhātha no brāhmaṇā ke nu tumhe”.
segments.ja535:14.1: “Cando ca sūriyo ca [sūriyo ca (ka.)] ubho idhāgatā, ayaṃ pana mātali devasārathi;
segments.ja535:14.3: Sakkohamasmi tidasānamindo, eso ca kho pañcasikhoti vuccati.
segments.ja535:15.1: “Pāṇissarā mudiṅgā ca [mutiṅgā ca (sī. syā. pī.)], murajālambarāni ca;
segments.ja535:16.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā nirayaṃ vajanti”.
segments.ja535:17.1: “Ye kecime suggatimāsamānā [suggatimāsasānā (sī. pī.), suggatāsisamānā (ka.)], dhamme ṭhitā saṃyame saṃvibhāge;
segments.ja535:17.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā sugatiṃ vajanti”.
segments.ja535:18.1: “Tvaṃ nosi ñāti purimāsu jātisu, so maccharī rosako [kosiyo (syā. ka.)] pāpadhammo;
segments.ja535:18.3: Taveva atthāya idhāgatamhā, mā pāpadhammo nirayaṃ gamittha”[apattha (ka. sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja535:19.1: “Addhā hi maṃ vo hitakāmā, yaṃ maṃ samanusāsatha;
segments.ja535:19.3: Sohaṃ tathā karissāmi, sabbaṃ vuttaṃ hitesibhi.
segments.ja535:20.1: “Esāhamajjeva upāramāmi, na cāpihaṃ [na cāpahaṃ (sī. pī.)] kiñci kareyya pāpaṃ;
segments.ja535:20.3: Na cāpi me kiñci adeyyamatthi, na cāpidatvā udakaṃ pivāmi [udakampahaṃ pibe (sī.)].
segments.ja535:21.1: “Evañca me dadato sabbakālaṃ [sabbakāle (ka.)], bhogā ime vāsava khīyissanti;
segments.ja535:21.3: Tato ahaṃ pabbajissāmi sakka, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikāni”.
segments.ja535:23.1: “Suciṃ sugandhaṃ tidasehi sakkataṃ, pupphuttamaṃ amaravarehi sevitaṃ;
segments.ja535:23.3: Aladdha maccehi va dānavehi vā, aññatra devehi tadārahaṃ hidaṃ [hitaṃ (syā.)].
segments.ja535:24.1: “Tato catasso kanakattacūpamā, uṭṭhāya nāriyo pamadādhipā muniṃ;
segments.ja535:24.3: Āsā ca saddhā ca sirī tato hirī, iccabravuṃ nāradadeva brāhmaṇaṃ.
segments.ja535:25.1: “Sace anuddiṭṭhaṃ tayā mahāmuni, pupphaṃ imaṃ pārichattassa brahme;
segments.ja535:25.3: Dadāhi no sabbā gati te ijjhatu, tuvampi no hohi yatheva vāsavo.
segments.ja535:26.3: Na mayhamatthatthi imehi koci naṃ, yāyeva vo seyyasi sā piḷandhatha”[piḷayhatha (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja535:27.3: Yassā hi no nārada tvaṃ padassasi, sāyeva no hehiti seṭṭhasammatā”.
segments.ja535:28.1: “Akallametaṃ vacanaṃ sugatte, ko brāhmaṇo saṃkalahaṃ udīraye;
segments.ja535:28.3: Gantvāna bhūtādhipameva pucchatha, sace na jānātha idhuttamādhamaṃ”.
segments.ja535:29.3: Sakāse [sakāsaṃ (ka.)] gantvāna sahassacakkhuno, pucchiṃsu bhūtādhipaṃ kā nu seyyasi”.
segments.ja535:30.1: “Tā disvā āyattamanā purindado, iccabravī devavaro katañjalī;
segments.ja535:30.3: Sabbāva vo hotha sugatte sādisī, ko neva bhadde kalahaṃ udīrayi”.
segments.ja535:31.1: “Yo sabbalokaccarito [sabbalokaṃ carako (sī. syā. pī.)] mahāmuni, dhamme ṭhito nārado [nārada (syā.)] saccanikkamo;
segments.ja535:31.3: So nobravi [bravī (sī. syā. pī.)] girivare gandhamādane, gantvāna bhūtādhipameva pucchatha;
segments.ja535:32.1: “Asu [asū (syā.)] brahāraññacaro mahāmuni, nādatvā bhattaṃ varagatte bhuñjati;
segments.ja535:32.3: Viceyya dānāni dadāti kosiyo, yassā hi so dassati sāva seyyasi”.
segments.ja535:33.1: “Asū hi yo sammati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gaṅgāya tīre himavantapassani [himavantapasmani (sī. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja535:33.3: Sa kosiyo dullabhapānabhojano, tassa sudhaṃ pāpaya devasārathi”.
segments.ja535:34.1: “Sa [so (syā.)] mātalī devavarena pesito, sahassayuttaṃ abhiruyha sandanaṃ;
segments.ja535:34.3: Sukhippameva [sa khippameva (sī. pī.)] upagamma assamaṃ, adissamāno munino sudhaṃ adā”.
segments.ja535:35.3: Sabbāni bhūtāni adhicca [aticca (sī. pī.)] vāsavo, ko neva me pāṇisu kiṃ sudhodahi.
segments.ja535:36.3: Adiṭṭhapubbaṃ mama jātu cakkhubhi [jātacakkhuhi (sī. pī.)], kā devatā pāṇisu kiṃ sudhodahi”.
segments.ja535:37.1: “Ahaṃ mahindena mahesi pesito, sudhābhihāsiṃ turito mahāmuni;
segments.ja535:37.3: Jānāsi maṃ mātali devasārathi, bhuñjassu bhattuttama mābhivārayi [mā vicārayi (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja535:38.1: “Bhuttā ca sā dvādasa hanti pāpake, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ aratiṃ daraklamaṃ [darathaṃ kilaṃ (syā.), darathakkhamaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja535:39.1: “Na kappatī mātali mayha bhuñjituṃ, pubbe adatvā iti me vatuttamaṃ;
segments.ja535:39.3: Na cāpi ekāsnamarīyapūjitaṃ [ekāsanaṃ ariyapūjitaṃ (sī. pī.)], asaṃvibhāgī ca sukhaṃ na vindati”.
segments.ja535:40.1: “Thīghātakā ye cime pāradārikā, mittadduno ye ca sapanti subbate;
segments.ja535:40.3: Sabbe ca te maccharipañcamādhamā, tasmā adatvā udakampi nāsniye [nāsmiye (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja535:41.1: “So hitthiyā vā purisassa vā pana, dassāmi dānaṃ vidusampavaṇṇitaṃ;
segments.ja535:41.3: Saddhā vadaññū idha vītamaccharā, bhavanti hete sucisaccasammatā”[sammasammatā (sī.)].
segments.ja535:42.1: “Ato matā [mutā (sī. pī.)] devavarena pesitā, kaññā catasso kanakattacūpamā;
segments.ja535:42.3: Āsā ca saddhā ca sirī tato hirī [sirī hirī tato (pī.)], taṃ assamaṃ āgamu [āgamuṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] yattha kosiyo.
segments.ja535:43.1: “Tā disvā sabbo paramappamodito [sabbā paramappamoditā (syā.)], subhena vaṇṇena sikhārivaggino;
segments.ja535:43.3: Kaññā catasso caturo catuddisā, iccabravī mātalino ca sammukhā.
segments.ja535:44.1: “Purimaṃ disaṃ kā tvaṃ pabhāsi devate, alaṅkatā tāravarāva osadhī;
segments.ja535:44.3: Pucchāmi taṃ kañcanavelliviggahe, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi devatā.
segments.ja535:45.1: “Sirāha devīmanujebhi [manujesu (sī. syā. pī.)] pūjitā, apāpasattūpanisevinī sadā;
segments.ja535:45.3: Sudhāvivādena tavantimāgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājaya.
segments.ja535:46.1: “Yassāhamicchāmi sudhaṃ [sukhaṃ (pī.)] mahāmuni, so [sa (sī. pī.)] sabbakāmehi naro pamodati;
segments.ja535:46.3: Sirīti maṃ jānahi jūhatuttama, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājaya”.
segments.ja535:47.1: “Sippena vijjācaraṇena buddhiyā, narā upetā paguṇā sakammunā [sakammanā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja535:47.3: Tayā vihīnā na labhanti kiñcanaṃ [kiñcinaṃ (ka.)], tayidaṃ na sādhu yadidaṃ tayā kataṃ.
segments.ja535:48.1: “Passāmi posaṃ alasaṃ mahagghasaṃ, sudukkulīnampi arūpimaṃ naraṃ;
segments.ja535:48.3: Tayānugutto siri jātimāmapi [jātimaṃ api (sī.)], peseti dāsaṃ viya bhogavā sukhī.
segments.ja535:49.1: “Taṃ taṃ asaccaṃ avibhajjaseviniṃ, jānāmi mūḷhaṃ vidurānupātiniṃ;
segments.ja535:49.3: Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasi”.
segments.ja535:50.3: Osittavaṇṇaṃ paridayha sobhasi, kusaggirattaṃ apiḷayha mañjariṃ.
segments.ja535:51.3: Ko te dutīyo idha mandalocane, na bhāyasi ekikā kānane vane”.
segments.ja535:52.1: “Na me dutīyo idha matthi kosiya, masakkasārappabhavamhi devatā;
segments.ja535:52.3: Āsā sudhāsāya tavantimāgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājaya”.
segments.ja535:53.1: “Āsāya yanti vāṇijā dhanesino, nāvaṃ samāruyha parenti aṇṇave;
segments.ja535:53.3: Te tattha sīdanti athopi ekadā, jīnādhanā enti vinaṭṭhapābhatā.
segments.ja535:54.1: “Āsāya khettāni kasanti kassakā, vapanti bījāni karontupāyaso;
segments.ja535:54.3: Ītīnipātena avuṭṭhitāya [avuṭṭhikāya (sī. pī.)] vā, na kiñci vindanti tato phalāgamaṃ.
segments.ja535:55.1: “Athattakārāni karonti bhattusu, āsaṃ purakkhatvā narā sukhesino;
segments.ja535:55.3: Te bhatturatthā atigāḷhitā puna, disā panassanti aladdha kiñcanaṃ.
segments.ja535:56.1: “Hitvāna [jahitva (sī. syā. pī.)] dhaññañca dhanañca ñātake, āsāya saggādhimanā sukhesino;
segments.ja535:56.3: Tapanti lūkhampi tapaṃ cirantaraṃ, kumaggamāruyha [kummaggamāruyha (sī. syā. pī.)] parenti duggatiṃ.
segments.ja535:57.1: “Āsā visaṃvādikasammatā ime, āse sudhāsaṃ [sudhāya (syā pī. ka.)] vinayassu attani;
segments.ja535:57.3: Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasi”.
segments.ja535:58.3: Pucchāmi taṃ kañcanavelliviggahe, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi devatā”.
segments.ja535:59.1: “Saddhāha devīmanujehi [devīmanujesu (sī. syā. pī.)] pūjitā, apāpasattūpanisevinī sadā;
segments.ja535:59.3: Sudhāvivādena tavantimāgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājaya”.
segments.ja535:60.1: “Dānaṃ damaṃ cāgamathopi saṃyamaṃ, ādāya saddhāya karonti hekadā;
segments.ja535:60.3: Theyyaṃ musā kūṭamathopi pesuṇaṃ, karonti heke puna viccutā tayā.
segments.ja535:61.3: Vinetvāna [vinetvā (sī. syā. pī.)] chandaṃ kulitthiyāsupi [kuladhītiyāsupi (sī. pī.)], karoti saddhaṃ puna [pana (sī. pī.)] kumbhadāsiyā.
segments.ja535:62.1: “Tvameva saddhe paradārasevinī, pāpaṃ karosi kusalampi riñcasi;
segments.ja535:62.3: Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasi”.
segments.ja535:63.3: Tathūpamā maṃ paṭibhāsi devate, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi accharā.
segments.ja535:64.3: Kā tiṭṭhasi mandamigāvalokayaṃ [mandamivāvalokayaṃ (sī. pī.)], bhāsesamānāva giraṃ na muñcasi”.
segments.ja535:65.3: Sudhāvivādena tavantimāgatā, sāhaṃ na sakkomi sudhampi yācituṃ;
segments.ja535:66.1: “Dhammena ñāyena sugatte lacchasi, eso hi dhammo na hi yācanā sudhā;
segments.ja535:66.3: Taṃ taṃ ayācantimahaṃ nimantaye, sudhāya yañcicchasi tampi dammi te.
segments.ja535:67.1: “Sā tvaṃ mayā ajja sakamhi assame, nimantitā kañcanavelliviggahe;
segments.ja535:67.3: Tuvañhi me sabbarasehi pūjiyā, taṃ pūjayitvāna sudhampi asniye”.
segments.ja535:68.1: “Sā kosiyenānumatā jutīmatā, addhā hiri rammaṃ pāvisi yassamaṃ;
segments.ja535:69.1: “Rukkhaggahānā bahukettha pupphitā, ambā piyālā panasā ca kiṃsukā;
segments.ja535:69.3: Sobhañjanā loddamathopi padmakā, kekā ca bhaṅgā tilakā supupphitā.
segments.ja535:71.1: “Hareṇukā veḷukā keṇu [veṇu (sī. pī.)] tindukā, sāmākanīvāramathopi cīnakā;
segments.ja535:71.3: Mocā kadalī bahukettha sāliyo, pavīhayo ābhūjino ca [ābhujinopi (sī. syā.)] taṇḍulā.
segments.ja535:72.1: “Tassevuttarapassena [tassa ca uttare passe (sī. pī.), tassa ca uttarapassena (syā.)], jātā pokkharaṇī sivā;
segments.ja535:73.3: Siṅgū savaṅkā saṃkulā [sakulā (sī. syā. pī.)], satavaṅkā ca rohitā;
segments.ja535:74.3: Haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca, cakkavākā ca kukkuhā;
segments.ja535:76.1: “Palāsādā gavajā ca, mahiṃsā [mahisā (sī. syā. pī.)] rohitā rurū;
segments.ja535:76.3: Eṇeyyā ca varāhā ca, gaṇino nīkasūkarā;
segments.ja535:78.3: Tassā susambandhasiraṃ kusāmayaṃ, suciṃ sugandhaṃ ajinūpasevitaṃ;
segments.ja535:78.5: Atricca [atriccha (sī. syā. pī.)] kocchaṃ hirimetadabravi,‘nisīda kalyāṇi sukhayidamāsanaṃ’.
segments.ja535:79.1: “Tassā tadā kocchagatāya kosiyo, yadicchamānāya jaṭājinandharo [jaṭājutindharo (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja535:79.3: Navehi pattehi sayaṃ sahūdakaṃ, sudhābhihāsī turito mahāmuni.
segments.ja535:80.1: “Sā taṃ paṭiggayha ubhohi pāṇibhi, iccabravi attamanā jaṭādharaṃ;
segments.ja535:80.3: ‘Handāhaṃ etarahi pūjitā tayā, gaccheyyaṃ brahme tidivaṃ jitāvinī’.
segments.ja535:81.3: Sakāse gantvāna sahassacakkhuno, ayaṃ sudhā vāsava dehi me jayaṃ.
segments.ja535:82.1: “Tamena [tamenaṃ (syā. ka.)] sakkopi tadā apūjayi, sahindadevā [sahindā ca devā (sī. pī.)] surakaññamuttamaṃ;
segments.ja535:82.3: Sā pañjalī devamanussapūjitā, navamhi kocchamhi yadā upāvisi”.
segments.ja535:83.1: “Tameva saṃsī [tameva asaṃsī (syā.)] punadeva mātaliṃ, sahassanetto tidasānamindo;
segments.ja535:83.3: Gantvāna vākyaṃ mama brūhi kosiyaṃ, āsāya saddhā [saddha (pī.)] siriyā ca kosiya;
segments.ja535:84.1: “Taṃ su vatthaṃ udatārayī rathaṃ, daddallamānaṃ upakāriyasādisaṃ [upakiriyasādisaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja535:85.3: Eṇeyyakā laṅghamayettha pakkhino [pakkhiyo (sī. pī.)], migettha veḷuriyamayā yudhā yutā.
segments.ja535:87.1: “Taṃ yānaseṭṭhaṃ abhiruyha mātali, disā imāyo [dasa disā imā (sī. syā. pī.)] abhinādayittha;
segments.ja535:87.3: Nabhañca selañca vanappatiniñca [vanaspatīni ca (sī. pī.), vanappatiñca (syā. ka.)], sasāgaraṃ pabyadhayittha [pabyāthayittha (sī. pī.)] mediniṃ.
segments.ja535:88.3: Bahussutaṃ vuddhaṃ vinītavantaṃ, iccabravī mātali devabrāhmaṇaṃ.
segments.ja535:89.1: “Indassa vākyaṃ nisāmehi kosiya, dūto ahaṃ pucchati taṃ purindado;
segments.ja535:89.3: Āsāya saddhā siriyā ca kosiya, hirī sudhaṃ kena malattha hetunā”.
segments.ja535:90.1: “Andhā sirī maṃ paṭibhāti mātali, saddhā aniccā pana devasārathi;
segments.ja535:90.3: Āsā visaṃvādikasammatā hi me, hirī ca ariyamhi guṇe patiṭṭhitā”.
segments.ja535:91.1: “Kumāriyo yācimā gottarakkhitā, jiṇṇā ca yā yā ca sabhattuitthiyo;
segments.ja535:91.3: Tā chandarāgaṃ purisesu uggataṃ, hiriyā nivārenti sacittamattano.
segments.ja535:92.3: Hiriyā nivattanti jahitva [jahitvāna (syā. ka.)] jīvitaṃ, te sampaṭicchanti punā hirīmanā.
segments.ja535:93.1: “Velā yathā sāgaravegavārinī, hirāya hi pāpajanaṃ nivārinī;
segments.ja535:93.3: Taṃ sabbaloke hirimariyapūjitaṃ, indassa taṃ vedaya devasārathi”.
segments.ja535:94.1: “Ko te imaṃ kosiya diṭṭhimodahi, brahmā mahindo atha vā pajāpati;
segments.ja535:94.3: Hirāya devesu hi seṭṭhasammatā, dhītā mahindassa mahesi jāyatha”.
segments.ja535:95.1: “Handehi dāni tidivaṃ apakkama [samakkama (sī. pī.)], rathaṃ samāruyha mamāyitaṃ imaṃ [idaṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja535:95.3: Indo ca taṃ indasagotta kaṅkhati, ajjeva tvaṃ indasahabyataṃ vaja”.
segments.ja535:96.1: “Evaṃ visujjhanti [samijjhanti (sī. pī.)] apāpakammino, atho suciṇṇassa phalaṃ na nassati;
segments.ja535:96.3: Ye keci maddakkhu sudhāya bhojanaṃ, sabbeva te indasahabyataṃ gatā”.

lines: Ye keci sugatiṃ āsīsanti, sabbe te saṃyamasaṅkhāte dasasīladhamme saṃvibhāgasaṅkhāte dānadhamme ca ṭhitā hutvā idha sarīrasaṅkhātaṃ dehaṃ nikkhipitvā tassa kāyassa bhedā sugatiṃ vajantīti attho.
Evaṃ vatvā ca pana,“kosiya, na mayaṃ tava santike pāyāsatthāya āgatā, kāruññena pana taṃ anukampamānā āgatāmhā”ti tassa pakāsetuṃ āha –
“Tvaṃ nosi ñāti purimāsu jātisu, so maccharī rosako pāpadhammo;
Taveva atthāya idhāgatamhā, mā pāpadhammo nirayaṃ gamitthā”ti.
Mā pāpadhammoti ayaṃ amhākaṃ ñāti pāpadhammo mā nirayaṃ agamāti etadatthaṃ āgatamhāti attho.
Taṃ sutvā kosiyo “atthakāmā kira me, ete maṃ nirayā uddharitvā sagge patiṭṭhāpetukāmā”ti tuṭṭhacitto āha –
“Addhā maṃ vo hitakāmā, yaṃ maṃ samanusāsatha;
Sohaṃ tathā karissāmi, sabbaṃ vuttaṃ hitesibhi.
“Esāhamajjeva uparamāmi, na cāhaṃ kiñci kareyya pāpaṃ;
Na cāpi me kiñci adeyyamatthi, na cāpidatvā udakaṃ pivāmi.
“Evañca me dadato sabbakālaṃ, bhogā ime vāsava khīyissanti;
Tato ahaṃ pabbajissāmi sakka, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikānī”ti.
Yaṃ manti yena maṃ samanusāsatha, tena me tumhe hitakāmā.
Adeyyamatthīti ito paṭṭhāya ca mama ālopato upaḍḍhampi adeyyaṃ nāma natthi, na cāpidatvāti udakapasatampi cāhaṃ labhitvā adatvā na pivissāmi.
Sakko macchariyakosiyaṃ dametvā nibbisevanaṃ katvā dānaphalaṃ jānāpetvā dhammadesanāya pañcasu sīlesu patiṭṭhāpetvā saddhiṃ tehi devanagarameva gato.

Macchariyakosiyopi nagaraṃ pavisitvā rājānaṃ anujānāpetvā “gahitagahitabhājanāni pūretvā gaṇhantū”ti yācakānaṃ dhanaṃ datvā tasmiṃ khīṇe nikkhamma himavantato dakkhiṇapasse gaṅgāya ceva ekassa ca jātassarassa antare paṇṇasālaṃ katvā pabbajitvā vanamūlaphalāhāro tattha ciraṃ vihāsi, jaraṃ pāpuṇi.
Tadā sakkassa āsā saddhā sirī hirīti catasso dhītaro honti.
Tā bahuṃ dibbagandhamālaṃ ādāya udakakīḷanatthāya anotattadahaṃ gantvā tattha kīḷitvā manosilātale nisīdiṃsu.

Tasmiṃ khaṇe nārado nāma brāhmaṇatāpaso tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ divāvihāratthāya gantvā nandanavanacittalatāvanesu divāvihāraṃ katvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ chattaṃ viya chāyatthāya dhārayamāno manosilātalamatthakena attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ kañcanaguhaṃ gacchati.
Atha tā tassa hatthe taṃ pupphaṃ disvā yāciṃsu.
“Suciṃ sugandhaṃ tidasehi sakkataṃ, pupphuttamaṃ amaravarehi sevitaṃ;
Aladdha maccehiva dānavehi vā, aññatra devehi tadārahaṃ hidaṃ.
“Tato catasso kanakattacūpamā, uṭṭhāya nāriyo pamadādhipā muniṃ;
Āsā ca saddhā ca sirī tato hirī, iccabravuṃ nāradadeva brāhmaṇaṃ.
“Sace anuddiṭṭhaṃ tayā mahāmuni, pupphaṃ imaṃ pārichattassa bramhe;
Dadāhi no sabbā gati te ijjhatu, tuvampi no hohi yatheva vāsavo.
Na mayhamatthatthi imehi koci naṃ, yāyeva vo seyyasi sā piḷandhathā”ti.
Sabbalokagūti devaloke ca manussaloke ca sabbattha gamanasamattho.
Dumavarasākhamādiyāti sākhāya jātattā dumavarasākhanti laddhanāmaṃ pupphaṃ gahetvā.
Aññatra devehīti ṭhapetvā deve ca iddhimante ca aññehi manussehi vā yakkhādīhi vā aladdhaṃ.
Tadārahaṃ hidanti tesaṃyeva hi taṃ arahaṃ anucchavikaṃ.
Uṭṭhāyāti ayyo mālāgandhavilepanādipaṭivirato pupphaṃ na piḷandhissati, ekasmiṃ padese chaḍḍessati, etha taṃ yācitvā pupphaṃ piḷandhissāmāti hatthe pasāretvā yācamānā ekappahāreneva uṭṭhahitvā.
Sabbā gati te ijjhatūti sabbā te cittagati ijjhatu, patthitapatthitassa lābhī hohīti tassa thulimaṅgalaṃ vadanti.
Yatheva vāsavoti yathā amhākaṃ pitā vāsavo icchiticchitaṃ deti, tatheva no tvampi hohīti.
Imehīti imehi pupphehi nāma mayhaṃ attho natthi, paṭivirato ahaṃ mālādhāraṇatoti dīpeti.
Yāyeva vo seyyasīti yā tumhākaṃ antare jeṭṭhikā.
Tā catassopi tassa vacanaṃ sutvā gāthamāhaṃsu –
Yassā hi no nārada tvaṃ padassasi, sāyeva no hehiti seṭṭhasammatā”ti.
Tattha tvaṃ nottamevāti uttamamahāmuni tvameva no upadhārehi.
Tāsaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā nārado tā ālapanto gāthamāha –
“Akallametaṃ vacanaṃ sugatte, ko brāhmaṇo saṃkalahaṃ udīraye;
Gantvāna bhūtādhipameva pucchatha, sace na jānātha idhuttamādhamen”ti.

Tassattho – bhadde sugatte, idaṃ tumhehi vuttaṃ vacanaṃ mama ayuttaṃ, evañhi sati mayā tumhesu ekaṃ seṭṭhaṃ, sesā hīnā karontena kalaho vaḍḍhito bhavissati, ko bāhitapāpo brāhmaṇo kalahaṃ udīraye vaḍḍheyya.
Evarūpassa hi kalahavaḍḍhanaṃ nāma ayuttaṃ, tasmā ito gatvā attano pitaraṃ bhūtādhipaṃ sakkameva pucchatha, sace attano uttamaṃ adhamañca na jānāthāti.
Sakāse gantvāna sahassacakkhuno, pucchiṃsu bhūtādhipaṃ kā nu seyyasī”ti.
Tattha paramappakopitāti pupphaṃ adadantena ativiya kopitā tassa kupitā hutvā.
Kā nūti amhākaṃ antare katamā uttamāti pucchiṃsu.
“Tā disvā āyattamanā purindado, iccabravī devavaro katañjalī;
Sabbāva vo hotha sugatte sādisī, koneva bhadde kalahaṃ udīrayī”ti.
Tattha tā disvāti, bhikkhave, catassopi attano santikaṃ āgatā disvā.
Kalahaṃ udīrayīti idaṃ nānāgāhaṃ viggahaṃ kathesi vaḍḍhesi.
“Yo sabbalokaccarito mahāmuni, dhamme ṭhito nārado saccanikkamo;
So nobravi girivare gandhamādane, gantvāna bhūtādhipameva pucchatha;

Taṃ sutvā sakko “imā catassopi mayhaṃ dhītarova, sacāhaṃ ‘etāsu ekā guṇasampannā uttamā’ti vakkhāmi, sesā kujjhissanti, na sakkā ayaṃ aḍḍo vinicchinituṃ, imā himavante kosiyatāpasassa santikaṃ pesesāmi, so etāsaṃ aḍḍaṃ vinicchinissatī”ti cintetvā “ahaṃ tumhākaṃ aḍḍaṃ na vinicchinissāmi, himavante kosiyo nāma tāpaso atthi, tassāhaṃ attano sudhābhojanaṃ pesessāmi, so parassa adatvā na bhuñjati, dadanto ca vicinitvā guṇavantānaṃ deti, yā tumhesu tassa hatthato bhattaṃ labhissati, sā uttamā bhavissatī”ti ācikkhanto gāthamāha –
“Asu brahāraññacaro mahāmuni, nādatvā bhattaṃ varagatte bhuñjati;
Yassā hi so dassati sāva seyyasī”ti.
Iti so tāpasassa santikaṃ pesetvā mātaliṃ pakkosāpetvā tassa santikaṃ pesento anantaraṃ gāthamāha –
“Asū hi yo sammati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ, gaṅgāya tīre himavantapassani;
Sa kosiyo dullabhapānabhojano, tassa sudhaṃ pāpaya devasārathī”ti.
“Sa mātalī devavarena pesito, sahassayuttaṃ abhiruyha sandanaṃ;
Sukhippameva upagamma assamaṃ, adissamāno munino sudhaṃ adā”ti.

Tattha adissamānoti, bhikkhave, so mātali devarājassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā taṃ assamaṃ gantvā adissamānakāyo hutvā tassa sudhaṃ adāsi, dadamāno ca rattiṃ padhānamanuyuñjitvā paccūsasamaye aggiṃ paricaritvā vibhātāya rattiyā udentaṃ sūriyaṃ namassamānassa ṭhitassa tassa hatthe sudhābhojanapātiṃ ṭhapesi.
Ko neva me pāṇisu kiṃ sudhodahi.
Adiṭṭhapubbaṃ mama jātu cakkhubhi, kā devatā pāṇisu kiṃ sudhodahī”ti.

Tattha udaggihuttanti udakaaggihuttaṃ paricaritvā aggisālato nikkhamma paṇṇasāladvāre ṭhatvā pabhaṅkaraṃ lokatamonudaṃ uttamaṃ ādiccaṃ upatiṭṭhato mama sabbāni bhūtāni adhicca atikkamitvā vattamāno vāsavo nu kho evaṃ mama pāṇīsu kiṃ sudhaṃ kiṃ nāmetaṃ odahi.
“Ahaṃ mahindena mahesi pesito, sudhābhihāsiṃ turito mahāmuni;
Jānāsi maṃ mātali devasārathi, bhuñjassu bhattuttama mābhivārayi.
“Bhuttā ca sā dvādasa hanti pāpake, khudaṃ pipāsaṃ aratiṃ daraklamaṃ;
Kodhūpanāhañca vivādapesuṇaṃ, sītuṇha tandiñca rasuttamaṃ idan”ti.
Jānāsīti jānāhi maṃ tvaṃ, ahaṃ mātali nāma devasārathīti attho.
Mābhivārayīti na bhuñjāmīti appaṭikkhipitvā bhuñja mā papañca kari.
Pāpaketi ayañhi sudhā bhuttā dvādasa pāpadhamme hanati.

Khudanti paṭhamaṃ tāva chātabhāvaṃ hanati, dutiyaṃ pānīyapipāsaṃ, tatiyaṃ ukkaṇṭhitaṃ, catutthaṃ kāyadarathaṃ, pañcamaṃ kilantabhāvaṃ, chaṭṭhaṃ kodhaṃ, sattamaṃ upanāhaṃ, aṭṭhamaṃ vivādaṃ, navamaṃ pesuṇaṃ, dasamaṃ sītaṃ, ekādasamaṃ uṇhaṃ, dvādasamaṃ tandiṃ ālasiyabhāvaṃ, idaṃ rasuttamaṃ uttamarasaṃ sudhābhojanaṃ ime dvādasa pāpadhamme hanati.
Taṃ sutvā kosiyo attano vatasamādānaṃ āvikaronto –
“Na kappatī mātali mayha bhuñjituṃ, pubbe adatvā iti me vatuttamaṃ;
Na cāpi ekāsnamariyapūjitaṃ, asaṃvibhāgī ca sukhaṃ na vindatī”ti.
Gāthaṃ vatvā,“bhante, tumhehi parassa adatvā bhojane kaṃ dosaṃ disvā idaṃ vataṃ samādinnan”ti mātalinā puṭṭho āha –
“Thīghātakā ye cime pāradārikā, mittadduno ye ca sapanti subbate;
Sabbe ca te maccharipañcamādhamā, tasmā adatvā udakampi nāsniye.
“Sohitthiyā vā purisassa vā pana, dassāmi dānaṃ vidusampavaṇṇitaṃ;
Saddhā vadaññū idha vītamaccharā, bhavanti hete sucisaccasammatā”ti.
Tattha pubbeti paṭhamaṃ adatvā, atha vā iti me pubbe vatuttamaṃ idaṃ pubbeva mayā vataṃ samādinnanti dasseti.
Na cāpi ekāsnamariyapūjitanti ekakassa asanaṃ na ariyehi buddhādīhi pūjitaṃ.
Tasmāti yasmā ahaṃ pañcamaadhamabhāvabhayena adatvā udakampi nāsniye na paribhuñjissāmīti imaṃ vataṃ samādiyiṃ.
Sucisaccasammatāti ete okappaniyasaddhāya samannāgatā vadaññū vītamaccharā purisā sucī ceva uttamasammatā ca hontīti attho.
Tasmiṃ khaṇe tā catasso devakaññāyo catuddisaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, sirī pācīnadisāya aṭṭhāsi, āsā dakkhiṇadisāya, saddhā pacchimadisāya, hirī uttaradisāya.
“Ato matā devavarena pesitā, kaññā catasso kanakattacūpamā;
Āsā ca saddhā ca sirī tato hirī, taṃ assamaṃ āgamu yattha kosiyo.
“Tā disvā sabbo paramappamodito, subhena vaṇṇena sikhārivaggino;
Kaññā catasso caturo catuddisā, iccabravī mātalino ca sammukhā.
“Purimaṃ disaṃ kā tvaṃ pabhāsi devate, alaṅkatā tāravarāva osadhī;
Pucchāmi taṃ kañcanavelliviggahe, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi devatā.
Sudhāvivādena tavantimāgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājaya.
“Yassāhamicchāmi sudhaṃ mahāmuni, so sabbakāmehi naro pamodati;
Sirīti maṃ jānahi jūhatuttama, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājayā”ti.
Matāti anumatā, atha devavarena anumatā ceva pesitā cāti attho.
“Sāman” tipi pāṭho, tā devatā sāmaṃ disvāti attho.
Ayameva vā pāṭho, cāturiyena samannāgatāti attho.
Bhājayāti yathā maṃ sudhā bhajati, tathā karohi, sudhaṃ me dehīti attho.
“Sippena vijjācaraṇena buddhiyā, narā upetā paguṇā sakammunā;
Tayā vihīnā na labhanti kiñcanaṃ, tayidaṃ na sādhu yadidaṃ tayā kataṃ.
“Passāmi posaṃ alasaṃ mahagghasaṃ, sudukkulīnampi arūpimaṃ naraṃ;
Tayānugutto siri jātimāmapi, peseti dāsaṃ viya bhogavā sukhī.
“Taṃ taṃ asaccaṃ avibhajjaseviniṃ, jānāmi mūḷhaṃ vidurānupātiniṃ;
Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasī”ti.
Kiñcananti kiñci appamattakampi yasaṃ vā sukhaṃ vā na labhanti.
Yadidanti yaṃ etaṃ issariyatthāya sippāni uggaṇhitvā carantānaṃ tayā vekallaṃ kataṃ, taṃ te na sādhu.
Avibhajjasevininti avibhajitvā yuttāyuttaṃ ajānitvā sippādisampannepi itarepi sevamānaṃ.
Vidurānupātininti paṇḍitānupātiniṃ paṇḍite pātetvā pothetvā viheṭhetvā caramānaṃ.
Kuto sudhāti tādisāya nigguṇāya kuto sudhābhojanaṃ, na me ruccasi, gaccha mā idha tiṭṭhāti.
Tato so āsāya saddhiṃ sallapanto āha –
Osittavaṇṇaṃ paridayha sobhasi, kusaggirattaṃ apiḷayha mañjariṃ.
Ko te dutīyo ida mandalocane, na bhāyasi ekikā kānane vane”ti.
Apiḷayha mañjarinti sapallavaṃ asokakaṇṇikaṃ kaṇṇe piḷandhitvāti vuttaṃ hoti.
Mandamivāti yathā sā migī bhītā vanantare ṭhatvā taṃ mandaṃ mandaṃ oloketi, evaṃ olokesi.
“Na me dutīyo idha matthi kosiya, masakkasārappabhavamhi devatā;
Āsā sudhāsāya tavantimāgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājayā”ti.
Taṃ sutvā kosiyo “tvaṃ kira yo te ruccati, tassa āsāphalanipphādanena āsaṃ desi, yo te na ruccati, tassa na desi, natthi tayā samā patthitatthavināsikā”ti dīpento āha –
“Āsāya yanti vāṇijā dhanesino, nāvaṃ samāruyha parenti aṇṇave;
Te tattha sīdanti athopi ekadā, jīnādhanā enti vinaṭṭhapābhatā.
“Āsāya khettāni kasanti kassakā, vapanti bījāni karontupāyaso;
Ītīnipātena avuṭṭhitāya vā, na kiñci vindanti tato phalāgamaṃ.
“Athattakārāni karonti bhattusu, āsaṃ purakkhatvā narā sukhesino;
Te bhatturatthā atigāḷhitā puna, disā panassanti aladdha kiñcanaṃ.
“Hitvāna dhaññañca dhanañca ñātake, āsāya saggādhimanā sukhesino;
Tapanti lūkhampi tapaṃ cirantaraṃ, kumaggamāruyha parenti duggatiṃ.
“Āsā visaṃvādikasammatā ime, āse sudhāsaṃ vinayassu attani;
Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasī”ti.
Iti tava vasena eke sampajjanti eke vipajjanti, natthi tayā sadisā pāpadhammāti vadati.
Tatoti tato sassato te kiñci phalaṃ na vindanti, tesampi āsacchedanakammaṃ tvameva karosīti vadati.
Iti etesampi issariyālābhaṃ tvameva karosīti vadati.
Āsā visaṃvādikasammatā imeti evaṃ ime sattā saggāsāya duggatiṃ gacchanti, tasmā tvaṃ āsā nāma visaṃvādikasammatā visaṃvādikāti saṅkhaṃ gatā.
Pucchāmi taṃ kañcanavelliviggahe, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi devate”ti.
Jighaññanāmavhayananti aparāti ca pacchimāti ca evaṃ jighaññena lāmakena nāmena vuccamānaṃ disaṃ pati daddallamānā tiṭṭhasi.
Sudhāvivādena tavanti māgatā, taṃ maṃ sudhāya varapañña bhājayā”ti.
Tattha saddhāti yassa kassaci vacanapattiyāyanā sāvajjāpi hoti anavajjāpi.
Apāpasattūpanisevinīti anavajjasaddhāya ca ekantapattiyāyanusabhāvāra paresupi pattiyāyanavidahanasamatthāya devatāyetaṃ nāmaṃ.
Athaṃ naṃ kosiyo “ime sattā yassa kassaci vacanaṃ saddahitvā taṃ taṃ karontā kattabbato akattabbameva bahutaraṃ karonti, taṃ sabbaṃ tayā kāritaṃ nāma hotī”ti vatvā evamāha –
“Dānaṃ damaṃ cāgamathopi saṃyamaṃ, ādāya saddhāya karonti hekadā;
Theyyaṃ musā kūṭamathopi pesuṇaṃ, karonti heke puna viccutā tayā.
Vinetvāna chandaṃ kulitthirāsupi, karoti saddhaṃ puna kumbhadāsiyā.
“Tvameva saddhe paradārasevinī, pāpaṃ karosi kusalampi riñcasi;
Na tādisī arahati āsanūdakaṃ, kuto sudhā gaccha na mayha ruccasī”ti.
Ādāya saddhāyāti “etāni dānādīni mahānisaṃsāni kattabbānī”ti vadataṃ vacanaṃ saddhāya ādiyitvāpi karonti ekadā.
Karonti heketi eke manussā evarūpesu nāma kālesu imesañca atthāya theyyādīni kattabbānīti kesañci vacanaṃ saddahitvā etānipi karonti.
Puna viccutā tayāti puna tayā visuttā sāvajjadukkhavipākānetāni na kattabbānīti vadataṃ vacanaṃ apattiyāyitvāpi karonti.
Iti tava vasena sāvajjampi anavajjampi kareyyāsi vadati.

Karoti saddhanti kumbhadāsiyāpi vacane saddhaṃ karoti, tassā “ahaṃ tumhākaṃ idaṃ nāma upakāraṃ karissāmī”ti vadantiyā pattiyāyitvā kulitthiyopi chaḍḍetvā tameva paṭisevati, asukā nāma tumhesu paṭibaddhacittāti kumbhadāsiyāpi vacane saddhaṃ katvāva paradāraṃ sevati.

Tvameva saddhe paradārasevinīti yasmā taṃ taṃ pattiyāyitvā tava vasena paradāraṃ sevanti pāpaṃ karonti kusalaṃ jahanti, tasmā tvameva paradārasevinī tvaṃ pāpāni karosi, kusalampi riñcasi, natthi tayā samā lokavināsikā pāpadhammā, gaccha na me ruccasīti.
Kosiyopi uttarato ṭhitāya hiriyā saddhiṃ sallapanto gāthādvayamāha –
Tathūpamā maṃ paṭibhāsi devate, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi accharā.
Kā tiṭṭhasi mandamigāvalokayaṃ, bhāsesamānāva giraṃ na muñcasī”ti.
Yāti yā puratthimā disā rattasuvaṇṇatāya uppamarūpadharā hutvā dissati.
Aggijārivāti aggijālā iva, sāpi nijjhāmakhettesu taruṇauṭṭhitakāḷavalli viyāti attho.
Kā tiṭṭhasīti yathā sā taruṇakāḷavalli vāteritā vilāsamānā sobhamānā tiṭṭhati, evaṃ kā nāma tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi.
Bhāsesamānāvāti mayā saddhiṃ bhāsitukāmā viya hosi, na ca giraṃ muñcasi.
Sudhāvivādena tavantimāgatā, sāhaṃ na sakkomi sudhampi yācituṃ;
Sudhampīti sā ahaṃ sudhābhojanaṃ taṃ yācitumpi na sakkomi.
Kopīnarūpā viya yācanitthiyā, yasmā itthiyā yācanā nāma kopīnarūpā viya rahassaṅgavivaraṇasadisā hoti, nillajjā viya hotīti attho.
Taṃ sutvā tāpaso dve gāthā abhāsi –
“Dhammena ñāyena sugatte lacchasi, eso hi dhammo na hi yācanā sudhā.
Taṃ taṃ ayācantimahaṃ nimantaye, sudhāya yañcicchasi tampi dammi te.
“Sā tvaṃ mayā ajja sakamhi assame, nimantitā kañcanavelliviggahe;
Tuvañhi me sabbarasehi pūjiyā, taṃ pūjayitvāna sudhampi asniye”ti.
Na hi yācanā sudhāti na hi yācanāya sudhā labbhati, teneva kāraṇena itarā tisso nalabhiṃsu.
Yañcicchasīti na kevalaṃ nimantemiyeva, yañca sudhaṃ icchasi, tampi dammi te.
Pūjiyāti na kevalaṃ sudhāya, aññehipi sabbarasehi tvaṃ mayā pūjetabbayuttakāva.
Asniyeti taṃ pūjetvā sace sudhāya avasesaṃ bhavissati, ahampi bhuñjissāmi.
“Sā kosiyenānumatā jutīmatā, addhā hiri rammaṃ pāvisi yassamaṃ;
“Rukkhaggahānā bahukettha pupphitā, ambā piyālā panasā ca kiṃsukā;
Sobhañjanā loddamathopi paddhakā, kekā ca bhaṅgā tilakā supupphitā.
Mocā kadalī bahukettha sāliyo, pavīhayo ābhūjino ca taṇḍulā.
Siṅgū savaṅkā saṃkulā, satavaṅkā ca rohitā;
Haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca, cakkavākā ca kukkuhā;
Eṇeyyā ca varāhā ca, gaṇino nīkasūkarā;
Sikhaṇḍīti uṭṭhitasikhā morā, aññepi vā matthake jātasikhā pakkhino.
Evarūpā tattha bhūmipabbatāti evaṃ bhagavā kosiyassa assamaṃ vaṇṇeti.
Idāni hirideviyā tattha pavisanādīni dassetuṃ āha –
Tassā susambandhasiraṃ kusāmayaṃ, suciṃ sugandhaṃ ajinūpasevitaṃ;
Atricca kocchaṃ hirimetadabravi, nisīda kalyāṇi sukhayidamāsanaṃ.
Navehi pattehi sayaṃ sahūdakaṃ, sudhābhihāsī turito mahāmuni.
“Sā taṃ paṭiggayha ubhohi pāṇibhi, iccabravi attamanā jaṭādharaṃ;
Handāhaṃ etarahi pūjitā tayā, gaccheyyaṃ brahme tidivaṃ jitāvinī.
Sakāse gantvāna sahassacakkhuno, ayaṃ sudhā vāsava dehi me jayaṃ.
Sā pañjalī devamanussapūjitā, navamhi kocchamhi yadā upāvisī”ti.
Nīladumābhilambitāti nīlesu dumesu abhilambitā hutvā, taṃ taṃ nīladumasākhaṃ parāmasantīti attho.
Mahāmegharivāti tena nimantitā mahāmeghavijju viya tassa taṃ assamaṃ pāvisi.
Sugandhanti usīrena ceva aññena sugandhatiṇena ca missakattā sugandhaṃ.
Udīritāti tidasapuraṃ gantvā sakkassa santike ayaṃ sudhāti udīrayi.
Sā pañjalī devamanussapūjitāti pañjalī devehi ca manussehi ca pūjitā.
Yadāti yadā nisīdanatthāya sakkena dāpite nave kañcanapīṭhasaṅkhāte kocche sā upāvisi, tadā naṃ tattha nisinnaṃ sakko ca sesadevatā ca pāricchattakapupphādīhi pūjayiṃsu.
“kena nu kho kāraṇena kosiyo sesānaṃ adatvā imissāva sudhaṃ adāsī”ti.
So tassa kāraṇassa jānanatthāya puna mātaliṃ pesesi.
Gantvāna vākyaṃ mama brūhi kosiyaṃ, āsāya saddhā siriyā ca kosiya;
Āsāya saddhā siriyā cāti āsāto ca saddhāto ca sirito ca hirīyeva kena hetunā sudhamalatthāti.
So tassa vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā vejayantarathamāruyha agamāsi.
Eṇeyyakā laṅghamayettha pakkhino, migettha veḷuriyamayā yudhā yutā.
“Taṃ yānaseṭṭhaṃ abhiruyha mātali, disā imāyo abhinādayittha;
Nabhañca selañca vanappatiniñca, sasāgaraṃ pabyathayittha mediniṃ.
Bahussutaṃ vuddhaṃ vinītavantaṃ, iccabravi mātali devabrāhmaṇaṃ.
“Indassa vākyaṃ nisāmehi kosiya, dūto ahaṃ pucchati taṃ purindado;
Āsāya saddhā siriyā ca kosiya, hirī sudhaṃ kena malattha hetunā”ti.
Tattha taṃ suplavatthanti taṃ vejayantarathaṃ sukhena plavanatthaṃ.
Upakāriyasādisanti upakaraṇabhaṇḍehi sadisaṃ, yathā tassa aggisikhāya samānavaṇṇāni upakaraṇāni jalanti, tatheva jalitanti attho.
Laṅghamayettha pakkhinoti ettha rathe laṅghamayā nānāratanamayā pakkhigaṇāpi paṭipāṭiyā ṭhitā.
Yudhā yutāti attano attano yudhena saddhiṃ yuttā hutvā dassitā.
Asaṅgīteti nissaṅge sīghajave evarūpe assarāje tattha yojesunti attho.
Iccabravīti rathaṃ ākāse ṭhapetvā otaritvā evaṃ abravi.
“Andhā sirī maṃ paṭibhāti mātali, saddhā aniccā pana devasārathi.
Āsā visaṃvādikasammatā hi me, hirī ca ariyamhi guṇe patiṭṭhitā”ti.
Tattha andhāti sippādisampannepi asampannepi bhajanato “andhā”ti maṃ paṭibhāti.
Aniccāti saddhā pana taṃ taṃ vatthuṃ pahāya aññasmiṃ aññasmiṃ uppajjanato hutvā abhāvākārena “aniccā”ti maṃ paṭibhāti.
Visaṃvādikasammatāti āsā pana yasmā dhanatthikā nāvāya samuddaṃ pakkhanditvā vinaṭṭhapābhatā enti, tasmā “visaṃvādikā”ti maṃ paṭibhāti.
Ariyamhi guṇeti hirī pana hirottappasabhāvasaṅkhāte parisuddhe ariyaguṇe patiṭṭhitāti.
“Kumāriyo yācimā gottarakkhitā, jiṇṇā ca yā yā ca sabhattuitthiyo;
Tā chandarāgaṃ purisesu uggataṃ, hiriyā nivārenti sacittamattano.
Hiriyā nivattanti jahitva jīvitaṃ, te sampaṭicchanti punā hirīmanā.
“Velā yathā sāgaravegavārinī, hirāya hi pāpajanaṃ nivārinī;
Taṃ sabbaloke hirimariyapūjitaṃ, indassa taṃ vedaya devasārathī”ti.
Attanoti tā sabbāpi parapurisesu attano chandarāgaṃ uggataṃ viditvā “ayuttametaṃ amhākan”ti hiriyā sacittaṃ nivārenti, pāpakammaṃ na karonti.
Jahitva jīvitanti ye hirimanto honti, te attano jīvitaṃ cajitvā hiriyā nivattanti, evaṃ nivattā ca pana te hirīmanā puna attano sāmikaṃ sampaṭicchanti, amittahatthato mocetvā gaṇhanti.
Pāpajanaṃ nivārinīti pāpato janaṃ nivārinī, ayameva vā pāṭho.
Indassa taṃ vedayāti yasmā evaṃ mahāguṇā ariyapūjitāvesā, tasmā taṃ evaṃ uttamā nāmesāti indassa kathehīti.
“Ko te imaṃ kosiya diṭṭhimodahi, brahmā mahindo atha vā pajāpati;
Hirāya devesu hi seṭṭhasammatā, dhītā mahindassa mahesi jāyathā”ti.
Seṭṭhasammatāti tava santike sudhāya laddhakālato paṭṭhāya indassa santike kañcanāsanaṃ labhitvā sabbadevatāhi pūjiyamānā uttamasammatā jāyatha.
Evaṃ tasmiṃ kathenteyeva kosiyassa taṅkhaṇaññeva cavanadhammo jāto.
Atha naṃ, mātali,“kosiya āyusaṅkhāro te ossaṭṭho, cavanadhammopi te sampatto, kiṃ te manussalokena, devalokaṃ gacchāmā”ti tattha netukāmo hutvā gāthamāha –
“Handehi dāni tidivaṃ apakkama, rathaṃ samāruyha mamāyitaṃ imaṃ;
Indo ca taṃ indasagotta kaṅkhati, ajjeva tvaṃ indasahabyataṃ vajā”ti.
Iti tasmiṃ kosiyena saddhiṃ kathenteyeva kosiyo cavitvā opapātiko devaputto hutvā āruyha dibbarathe aṭṭhāsi.
Atha naṃ, mātali, sakkassa santikaṃ nesi.
Sakko taṃ disvāva tuṭṭhamānaso attano dhītaraṃ hirideviṃ tassa aggamahesiṃ katvā adāsi, aparimāṇamassa issariyaṃ ahosi.
Tamatthaṃ viditvā “anomasattānaṃ kammaṃ nāma evaṃ visujjhatī”ti satthā osānagāthamāha –
“Evaṃ visujjhanti apāpakammino, atho suciṇṇassa phalaṃ na nassati;
Ye keci maddakkhu sudhāya bhojanaṃ, sabbeva te indasahabyataṃ gatā”ti.
Tattha apāpakamminoti apāpakammā sattā evaṃ visujjhanti ye keci maddakkhūti ye keci sattā tasmiṃ himavantapadese tadā kosiyena hiriyā dīyamānaṃ sudhābhojanaṃ addasaṃsu.
Sabbeva teti te sabbepi taṃ dānaṃ anumoditvā cittaṃ pasādetvā indasahabyataṃ gatāti.
